# Eternal Repos

> Eternal Repos (Tribute in Motion) is India's first purpose-built ceremonial mobility brand — thoughtfully designed vehicles and human care that bring dignity, calm and presence to families and institutions through the final journey. Based in Noida and serving Delhi NCR. Founded by Shaily Sharma.

## About
- [Our Story](https://eternalrepos.com/our-story): How and why Eternal Repos began.
- [About](https://eternalrepos.com/about): The brand, its people and its promise.
- [Vision](https://eternalrepos.com/vision): Where Eternal Repos is headed.
- [A Word of Trust](https://eternalrepos.com/a-word-of-trust): Founder's note on ET NOW's recognition for Excellence in Creating Dignified Farewell Journeys.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://eternalrepos.com/services): The full range of care.
- [Immediate Relief & Transport](https://eternalrepos.com/services/immediate-relief-transport): Prompt, dignified transport when it cannot wait.
- [Serene Gatherings & Remembrance](https://eternalrepos.com/services/serene-gatherings-remembrance): Spaces and support for remembrance.
- [Natural Beauty & Reverence](https://eternalrepos.com/services/natural-beauty-reverence): Care rooted in reverence.
- [Empathic Care & Keepsakes](https://eternalrepos.com/services/empathic-care-keepsakes): Compassionate care and keepsakes.
- [Reassuring Peace of Mind](https://eternalrepos.com/services/reassuring-peace-of-mind): Reliability and calm for families.
